decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated a mix of backpacks including a large internal frame hiking pack (High Sierra), a durable EDC bag (Maxpedition), and specialized hydration packs (Mubasel and Gelindo). However, the ZOMAKE 20L packable daypack (prod_backpacks_173) stands out as an exceptional value with over 14,000 reviews and a high rating of 4.6. Its versatility for travel and light hiking, combined with its extremely low price point and proven popularity, makes it the most logical purchase in this session.
